messages:
Anna L: Kicking off a quiet staged rollout for v2.0.1 -> target 10% -> 25% during late change window (ends 02:00 PT). Release note: improved attention kernel ordering, INT8 variant.
deploy-bot: Rollout initiated: v2.0.1 INT8 variant. Phase: ramp 10% -> 25%. Excluding na-central. Expected steady state in ~10m.
Priya S: Watching embed route metrics. FYI I see a spike in ap-northeast error rate right after increasing to 16%. 0.1% -> 2.3% errors, mainly 500 timeout + a few `invalid_chunk` parser errors.
Tom H: Can you confirm if those are client-side rejections or runtime exceptions?
Priya S: quick tail shows `parse_chunk: unexpected EOF` inside grpc adapter on gw-07-ap-northeast. Stack points to quant decode path for int8.
Maya D: Ops, can we isolate by workload? If it's only the /v1/embeddings route we could pin embeddings in ap-northeast to v2.0.0 and continue.
ops-oncall: We can do region-route pinning. Suggested action: pin ap-northeast embeddings to v2.0.0 and hold global ramp.
Anna L: Good plan. Are there any autoscale or node restarts correlated?
ops-oncall: No autoscale events. gw-07 shows intermittent process restarts, likely oom during decode. We'll cordon gw-07 and drain traffic from that node.
deploy-bot: Suggested command: `/deploy patch-route --region ap-northeast --route embeddings --to v2.0.0 --retain-traffic 16%`
Tom H: I'll take quick kernel logs and see if decode buffer size differs for INT8 path. Priya, can you repro with smaller payloads?
Priya S: Starting repro on staging with similar payloads. Noticed that when payloads are chunked (>1MB) the adapter errors reproduce reliably.
Maya D: I'm updating the change window doc and release notes: "ap-northeast embeddings pinned to v2.0.0 due to parse_chunk errors on INT8 decode. Investigation ongoing; postponing further ramp until fix."
product-bot: Annotation: pinging product stakeholders per release policy. Notifying: @realtime-team.
ops-oncall: Patch applied: ap-northeast embeddings pinned to v2.0.0. Global ramp paused at 16%. Cordon gw-07.
Anna L: Quick stop/go vote: Resume ramp tonight after hotfix (thumbsup) vs hold until morning and full bake (hand). React to vote.
Tom H: :thumbsup: if hotfix can be validated within 30m
Priya S: :hand: prefer morning bake — chunking repro is flaky in staging right now
Maya D: :hand: hold — will update release notes and change window to reflect hold
Anna L: Tally: 1 thumbs, 2 hands -> consensus to hold. Filing incident INC-2026-046 and scheduling follow-up in morning 09:30 PT with infra + runtime.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 16%. Route pin applied. Incident created: INC-2026-046.
ops-oncall: We'll keep gw-07 cordoned and create a warmup pool for INT8 decode testing tomorrow. Reach out if you need access to logs.
Priya S: I'll continue repro and test a patch that disables chunked decode for INT8. Tom will validate kernel param change.
Maya D: Thanks team — closing stop/go. We'll reopen thread when tests pass or rollback is required. :white_check_mark:
